products.name: Waveshare ESP32-S31-Touch-LCD-4.3C
products.summary: 4.3 英寸 800×480 RGB565 / GT911；N16R16，精确包装 SKU，显示与输入数字子集。

interfaces.name: TF · SDMMC
interfaces.notes: Default 64 MiB FAT32; physical SDMMC/power-gate subset, factory mount not validated.

limitations: 已实现受真实 RGB/AXI-GDMA、完整 800×480 RGB565、引脚路由与 GPIO47 背光门控约束的显示子集；S31 LEDC 背光波形尚未实现。
GT911 单触点报告/确认、GPIO46 复位与 INT2 地址选择、GPIO61 BOOT、GPIO55 LED、PCF85063 和 QMI8658C 数字寄存器子集；原厂多点触摸、ES8389 音频、电池、电源、CAN-FD、RS485、USB Host 和无线未验收。
TF 卡具有 GPIO56 低有效电源门控与物理 SDMMC 引脚；默认 64 MiB FAT32 不表示原厂文件系统已通过。
官方同一型号出厂恢复镜像适用于三种包装 SKU；已核对完整镜像的芯片、分区、checksum/SHA 与容量，原厂启动和实机未验证。
按 N16R16 设置 16 MiB Flash/PSRAM；NOR/PLL/模拟输入沿用明确的名义模型假设，没有借用其他设备的实测 eFuse。
UIFlow1、UIFlow2、小智：本轮官方型号 README/资源页未列出精确 S31-Touch-LCD-4.3C 目标镜像；上游目标专项核验仍未知，不使用同名 S3 固件替代。
3D 来源：official-cad-partial；生产Three加载器/原生尺寸/屏幕射线/展开复位已检验；部分结构和光学尺寸有明确限制，未宣称浏览器WebGL或实物装配通过。
Model: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Model: Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.
Model: Native shared displayCAD accounts for3/1116 source components. S3 electronic assembly is explicitly omitted; replacementS31 PCB is markedUNKNOWN.
Model: Box SKU116.3×79×18mm packaging is documented but model shows only shared display/PCB envelope. The box and optional battery are not reconstructed yet.
Model: Viewing aperture95.54×54.36mm and800×480 pixelaspect conflict; image is letterboxed inside the documented aperture, not stretched. Optical active area calibration unresolved.
Model: BOOT/LED/ports are exposed through product controls and logs; locations are not fabricated on this partial mechanical model.

chronology.notes: Official storefront position is a scheduling proxy; firmware dates are not hardware release dates.

compatibility.note: Pinned official restore image for the single N16R16 board; packaging variants explicitly listed. Full factory boot not yet tested.

tests.scope: Native board GPIO/RGB/GT911/SD-gate protocol tests, not factory boot or WebGL acceptance.

Actual S31 guest instructions write RGB565 pixels and188AXI-GDMA descriptors toSRAM, route800×480 physicalRGB pins, then readBOOT61. Correct route showsRGB pixels; wrongPCLK41 or unlitGPIO47 staysblack. No host framebuffer injection; no factoryboot claim.

Actual productionThree loader, retainedsourcehashes, native geometry bounds, framebuffer rays, shellmaterial isolation, UNKNOWN label construction/exposure and inspection restoration. No WebGL or physical fit claim.
